_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: the mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so its oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🔣️oracle.json manifest. `comrak` parses AND renders CommonMark, so it can be BOTH the independent parser and the independent mutation performer — no shared entry in the manifest declares a `-mutate` capability, so this is a distinct id.

oracles.rationale: The reference CommonMark implementation of the Rust ecosystem (100% CommonMark/GFM spec compliant), parsed with `Options::default()` (no GFM extensions enabled, matching this subset's own honest CommonMark-only scope) so reference-style links, setext headings and pipe tables parse the same way this subset's own hand-rolled parser treats them. Used here both as the independent AST the block/inline-path mutations are performed against and as the independent reader every projection (of oracle output and of re-parsed subject output alike) goes through — never the producer's own reading of what it wrote. Deterministic, no network, no system dependencies, cross-platform.
